title: TC VeinGlow PC
description: An advanced vein mining mod with radial menu, RGB-customizable block outline highlighter, custom mining shapes, and a skill system for harvesting, tree-felling, and liquid handling.
body:
# TC VeinGlow

**TC VeinGlow** is an advanced vein mining mod for Minecraft 1.21.1, supporting **Fabric**, **Forge**, and **NeoForge**. It goes far beyond a standard vein miner — featuring a radial menu, RGB-customizable block outline highlighter, preset and custom mining shapes, and a full skill system.

---
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/hJbgdmS820s" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
## Features

### Smart Vein Mining
Break an entire ore vein, fell a whole tree, or harvest a full field in a single action. The mod uses a server-side Block Action Queue to process blocks smoothly without causing server lag.

### Radial Menu
Hold **G** to open the radial menu and instantly switch between mining modes — no need to memorize multiple keybinds.

### RGB Block Outline Highlighter
All blocks about to be mined are highlighted with a smooth outline. Fully customizable: pick any RGB color, adjust thickness, transition speed, or enable rainbow mode.

### Mining Shapes
Choose from built-in shapes or create your own:
| Menu Name                 | Description                                                                                  |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Standard (Face)**       | Expands through the 6 directly adjacent block faces.                                         |
| **Standard V2 (Edges)**   | Expands through faces and edge-adjacent blocks (18 directions).                              |
| **Standard V3 (Corners)** | Expands through faces, edges, and 3D corners (26 directions), providing the widest coverage. |
| **TreeCapitator**         | Cuts down an entire tree using the `#logs` tag and automatically replants saplings.          |
| **Tunnel 1×2**            | Mines a tunnel 1 block wide and 2 blocks high, extending in the direction you are looking.   |
| **Tunnel 3×3**            | Mines a 3×3 tunnel extending in the direction you are looking.                               |
| **Stair Up**              | Creates an upward staircase, moving up one block for each step forward.                      |
| **Stair Down**            | Creates a downward staircase, moving down one block for each step forward.                   |
| **3×3 Area**              | Mines a 3×3 area perpendicular to the face you are targeting.                                |
| **5×5 Area**              | Mines a 5×5 area perpendicular to the face you are targeting.                                |

### Skill System
- **Break Skill** — standard block breaking
- **Crop Harvest Skill** — harvest crops across a wide area and auto-replant
- **Bucket Skill** — collect or place liquids (water, lava) in bulk
- **Interact Skill** — strip logs, till soil, create paths, and more in bulk

### HUD Overlay
A compact on-screen display shows the current mode, active tool, and block count. Includes smooth toast notifications when you switch modes. Position, color, opacity, and style are fully customizable.

### In-Game Config GUI
All settings are accessible from inside the game — no need to edit config files manually. Includes tabs for General, Colors, Filters, Skills, Shapes, and Dashboard.

### Block Filter System
Manage a per-world blacklist/whitelist directly from the in-game menu. Supports Minecraft tag notation (e.g. `#minecraft:logs`, `#forge:ores`) for broad compatibility with other mods.

---

## Multiplayer Support
Fully supported. The mod must be installed on both **server and client**. All mining logic runs server-side to prevent cheating and reduce client load.

---

## Default Keybinds
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `V` | Activate Vein Mine (hold while breaking) |
| `G` | Open Radial Menu |
| `N` | Quick-cycle through shapes |
| `← / →` | Previous / Next shape |
| `1–9` | Quick-select shape slot |

All keybinds can be rebound in **Options > Controls**.

---

## Requirements

| Component | Version |
|-----------|---------|
| Minecraft | 1.21.1 |
| Java | 21 |
| Fabric Loader | >= 0.15.11 |
| Fabric API | 0.102.0+1.21.1 |
| NeoForge | 21.1.x |
| Forge | 52.1.x |

**Optional:** ModMenu (Fabric only) — opens the config screen from the main menu.
No other dependencies required.
